combinations.magnitude: Scram 2.8 vs Nav1.8 SLiP 2.6 nS/pF in Nav1.8-null neurons with 8-Br-cAMP
combinations.model: cultured adult DRG neurons from Nav1.8-null mice
combinations.evidence_quote: The Nav1.8 SLiP had no effect on Gmax in the basal state (Figure 3G; Scram SLiP 2.1 ± 0.2 nS/pF and Nav1.8 SLiP 2.0 ± 0.3 nS/pF) and addition of 8-Br-cAMP failed to produce a reduction in Gmax (Figure 3H; Scram SLiP 2.8 ± 0.3 nS/pF and Nav1.8 SLiP 2.6 ± 0.3 nS/pF), providing evidence that the Nav1.8 SLiP selectively displaces Nav1.8 from ankyrins.

combinations.magnitude: lack of SLiP efficacy when endocytosis inhibited (Figure S10)
combinations.evidence_quote: This is further strengthened by the lack of efficacy of the Nav1.8 SLiP when clathrin-mediated endocytosis was inhibited by PitStop2 (Figure S10).
